(video, objectType) => {
  // 1. Block any channel with YouTube's official Music Note (Artist) badge
  if (video.channelBadges && video.channelBadges.includes("artist")) {
    return true;
  }

  // 2. Block YouTube auto-generated "Mix" playlists
  if (objectType === "mix" || objectType === "playlist") {
    if (video.title && video.title.toLowerCase().includes("mix")) {
      return true;
    }
  }

  // 3. Block by title keywords
  const musicKeywords = [
    "song", "songs", "music", "audio", "lyric", "lyrics", "lyrical",
    "mv", "music video", "official video", "full video", "video song",
    "remix", "mashup", "lofi", "lo-fi", "slowed", "reverb", "unplugged",
    "cover", "acoustic", "instrumental", "karaoke", "bgm", "ringtone",
    "album", "ep", "single", "track", "ost", "soundtrack", "theme song",
    "jukebox", "playlist", "nonstop", "non-stop", "medley",
    "singer", "feat", "ft.", "ft ", "concert", "live performance",
    "dj", "edm", "rap", "hip hop", "hip-hop", "pop", "rock", "jazz",
    "gaana", "gaane", "gane", "geet", "sangeet", "bhajan", "qawwali",
    "ghazal", "shabad", "kirtan", "aarti", "mantra", "chalisa",
    "bollywood", "punjabi", "haryanvi", "bhojpuri", "tamil", "telugu",
    "coke studio", "mtv unplugged", "t-series", "zee music",
    "sony music", "tips official", "yrf", "saregama", "speed records"
  ];

  // --- NEW ADDITION: Film Industry & Entertainment Title Keywords ---
  const entertainmentTitleKeywords = [
    // Film Industries
    "bollywood", "hollywood", "tollywood", "kollywood", "mollywood", "sandalwood",
    "pollywood", "bhojpuri", "marathi", "gujarati", "bengali", "south movie",
    "hindi dubbed", "dubbed movie", "film industry", "cinema",

    // Movies, Trailers & Clips
    "movie", "movies", "film", "films", "trailer", "teaser", "first look",
    "motion poster", "glimpse", "box office", "blockbuster", "superhit",
    "full movie", "movie scene", "climax", "deleted scene", "behind the scenes", "bts",

    // TV, OTT & Web Series
    "web series", "episode", "full episode", "promo", "serial", "natak",
    "netflix", "prime video", "hotstar", "jiocinema", "sonyliv", "zee5", "mx player",

    // General Entertainment, Comedy & Celebrity
    "entertainment", "comedy", "funny", "prank", "roast", "sketch", "spoof", "parody",
    "stand up", "standup", "kapil sharma", "bigg boss", "reality show", "audition",
    "celebrity", "celebs", "actor", "actress", "paparazzi", "spotted", "red carpet",
    "interview", "gossip", "bollywood news", "film review", "movie review", "vlog"
  ];

  if (video.title) {
    const titleLower = video.title.toLowerCase();
    if (musicKeywords.some(keyword => titleLower.includes(keyword))) {
      return true;
    }
    // Check new entertainment & film keywords
    if (entertainmentTitleKeywords.some(keyword => titleLower.includes(keyword))) {
      return true;
    }
  }

  // 4. Block by channel name
  if (video.channelName) {
    const channelLower = video.channelName.toLowerCase();
    const musicChannels = [
      " - topic", "vevo", "records", "music", 
      "t-series", "saregama", "tips", "yrf", "sony", "zee"
    ];

    // --- NEW ADDITION: Film Studios, TV Networks & Entertainment Channels ---
    const entertainmentChannels = [
      "entertainment", "films", "movies", "studios", "pictures", "production", "productions",
      "cinema", "telefilms", "talkies", "motion pictures", "box office",
      "dharma", "red chillies", "balaji", "eros", "viacom18", "pen movies", "goldmines",
      "shemaroo", "ultra", "rajshri", "excel entertainment", "maddock", "geetha arts",
      "mythri", "hombale", "lyca", "sun tv", "star plus", "colors", "sab tv", "set india",
      "mtv", "zoom", "pinkvilla", "bollywood hungama", "filmfare", "koimoi", "imdb",
      "warner bros", "universal", "paramount", "disney", "marvel", "dc", "lionsgate",
      "netflix", "amazon prime", "hotstar", "comedy", "vines", "tvf", "ashish chanchlani",
      "bb ki vines", "carryminati", "harsh beniwal", "round2hell"
    ];

    if (musicChannels.some(ch => channelLower.includes(ch))) {
      return true;
    }
    // Check new entertainment & film channels
    if (entertainmentChannels.some(ch => channelLower.includes(ch))) {
      return true;
    }
  }

  // --- NEW ADDITION: Superheroes, Franchises, Action Scenes & Dubbed Clips ---
  const franchiseAndSceneKeywords = [
    // Marvel & Avengers
    "avenger", "avengers", "marvel", "mcu", "iron man", "ironman", "thor", "hulk",
    "captain america", "spider-man", "spiderman", "black widow", "hawkeye",
    "doctor strange", "black panther", "thanos", "loki", "deadpool", "wolverine",
    "x-men", "guardians of the galaxy", "ant-man", "wanda", "scarlet witch",
    "endgame", "infinity war", "age of ultron", "civil war",

    // DC & Other Major Franchises
    "batman", "superman", "justice league", "joker", "wonder woman", "aquaman",
    "flash", "harry potter", "star wars", "fast and furious", "fast & furious",
    "john wick", "transformers", "jurassic", "mission impossible", "james bond",
    "avatar", "bahubali", "baahubali", "kgf", "pushpa", "rrr", "kalki", "pathaan", "jawan",

    // Scene & Dubbing Markers (Catches clips without the word "movie")
    "scene", "scenes", "fight", "battle", "vs", "entry", "mass entry", "attitude",
    "status", "whatsapp status", "shorts", "clip", "clips", "cut",
    "in hindi", "hindi dub", "dubbed", "4k", "hd scene", "imax", "best moment", "epic moment"
  ];

  if (video.title) {
    const titleLower = video.title.toLowerCase();
    if (franchiseAndSceneKeywords.some(keyword => titleLower.includes(keyword))) {
      return true;
    }
  }

  if (video.channelName) {
    const channelLower = video.channelName.toLowerCase();
    const clipChannels = [
      "scene", "clips", "dubbed", "hindi", "status", "edits", "editz", "marvel", "avenger"
    ];
    if (clipChannels.some(ch => channelLower.includes(ch))) {
      return true;
    }
  }

  return false;
}
